# CommonsOps

> CommonsOps pays for recurring public work with proof. A NEAR smart-contract
> registry tracks recurring work cycles, binds the claimant to the payout
> recipient, freezes immutable evidence, and links one-time onchain to a
> Sputnik DAO proposal. `PAID` is derived offchain from the finalized causal
> receipt graph of the real DAO transfer — approval alone is never payment.
> The registry is live on NEAR testnet with a fully executed, independently
> reviewed work cycle.

Live demo (recorded previews plus bounded live testnet reads; wallet optional):
https://super-user-root.github.io/CommonsOps/

## Core documents

- [README](README.md): product overview, live evidence table, do-X-see-Y
  reproducible steps, claim-to-evidence map, track mapping, FAQ
- [Testnet journey](docs/testnet-journey.md): the complete executed work
  cycle with explorer transaction links and receipt-level verification
- [Security findings](docs/p4-t02-findings.md): threat model, adversarial
  review findings and dispositions, onchain failure-path demonstrations
- [Release verification](docs/release-verification.md): why the live
  deployment is the release candidate (three-way identical WASM)
- [Demo guide](demo/README.md): screenshots mapped to journey steps and live
  evidence
- [Command reference](docs/COMMANDS.md): per-command setup, artifacts, the
  GitHub Pages export, and the CI description

## Code map

- [Contract entry](contracts/registry/src/lib.rs): near-sdk registry —
  templates, deterministic cycles, claims, immutable evidence, one-time
  proposal links
- [Contract domain](contracts/registry/src/domain.rs): core types and
  validation rules
- [Contract tests](contracts/registry/src/tests.rs): 58 Rust tests including
  the duplicate-claim guard
- [Domain model](packages/domain/src/index.ts): cycle/claim/evidence state
  machine shared by all packages
- [Proposal builder](packages/near/src/proposal-builder.ts): pinned Sputnik
  DAO profiles and exact `act_proposal` argument construction
- [Reconciliation engine](packages/near/src/reconciliation.ts): derives
  `PAID` from finalized receipt graphs; fingerprinted store with
  APPLIED / IDEMPOTENT / CONFLICT / NOT_APPLIED statuses
- [Snapshot transport](apps/web/lib/live/rpc.ts): official testnet primary/archival
  endpoints; max4 HTTP, 96 attempts, 6s fetch/body timeout, 40s refresh deadline;
  pinned block hash/height validation and lossless header U64 digits
- [Async state controller](apps/web/lib/live/latest-task.ts): latest-input gates,
  cancellation, stale retained data (not sendable); async behavior tests alongside
- [Web workspace](apps/web/app/page.tsx): recorded-journey stages plus a
  live registry section — real testnet RPC reads and user-signed
  transactions via an NEAR wallet selector (testnet-only)
- [Live smoke](scripts/smoke-testnet.mjs): read-only onchain deployment
  verification against the reviewed artifact
- [Live reconciliation](scripts/reconcile-live.mjs): read-only re-derivation
  of the recorded payout from chain data
- [E2E replay suite](tests/e2e/e2e-replay.test.ts): deterministic offline
  end-to-end replay including conflict and idempotency paths

## Verify (offline or read-only)

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm verify:offline` — format checks,
  strict TypeScript and current unit suites (counts printed by the runner),
  Rust contract tests, production build, release-WASM checks, loopback HTTP smoke
- `node scripts/smoke-testnet.mjs commonsops.testnet` — live onchain
  deployment equals the reviewed artifact (exit 0; throws on any mismatch)
- `node scripts/reconcile-live.mjs` — re-derives the recorded payout to
  APPLIED / PAID from live chain data

## Boundaries

- No token, no custody, no AI-driven approval, no cross-chain payments, no
  autonomous scheduler. Governance and treasury stay entirely inside the
  Sputnik DAO; payouts are never simulated in-app. The web workspace
  performs live testnet reads and user-signed transactions through the
  connected wallet (testnet-only, no keys in app code); recorded-journey
  stages render the exact recorded onchain data.
- Network: NEAR testnet only. License: MIT.
